summary: Galaxy Hut’s restaurant-issued site confirms the Arlington identity and directly links its Square ordering menu. The frozen extraction combines the vegetarian food catalog with a much larger rotating alcohol inventory and two merchandise products. Alcohol-only and merchandise rows are excluded from the POC food/nonalcoholic boundary, while current food and explicit nonalcoholic products are retained and two current food omissions are added. All four allergen search classes were completed without finding an official matrix or cross-contact statement; linked-menu positives are preserved and undisclosed allergens remain accurately unavailable.
